For an awaiting audio/video upload, uploadTarget describes where a separate file transfer must go; this tool does not transfer files.

functions.name: remove-tag-from-recording

tag.description: Exact existing tag spelling from get-recording; preserved without case folding or trimming.

functions.name: update-recording
functions.description: Replace a recording's title without changing its media, identity, tags, or sharing.

title.description: New title replacing the existing title. Required; null is not accepted. Empty string is an explicit attempt to clear the title, subject to provider validation.

recordingId.description: Opaque recording identifier to update.

FunctionInput_grain_api_key_updaterecord.description: Recording to update and the replacement title, sent without changing other recording fields.

success.description: Grain acknowledged the title update; not a reread of the recording.

recordingId.description: Recording targeted by the title update.

FunctionOutput_grain_api_key_updaterecor.description: Acknowledgment of the title update for the targeted recording.

tags.instructions: Use recordingId from `list-recordings`. This overwrites the title only; use `add-tag-to-recording` or the sharing tools for those changes. An empty title is submitted as an explicit empty string and may be rejected by Grain. Use `get-recording` to check the result after an uncertain write.

functions.name: update-upload
functions.description: Partially update recording attributes of an awaiting or staged upload created with automatic promotion disabled. Supplied lists and transcript replace those attributes; omitted attributes are preserved.

uploadId.description: Opaque identifier of the awaiting or staged upload to edit.

title.description: Replacement title; an empty string explicitly requests an empty title, subject to provider validation.

teamId.description: Replacement destination team identifier. Clearing the team is not exposed; omit to preserve it.

startAt.description: Replacement meeting occurrence instant, explicit UTC or numeric offset and at most millisecond precision; cannot be in the future. Clearing is not exposed.

transcript.description: Complete replacement transcript; an empty segments array requests clearing its text while retaining the language.

language.description: Transcript language code, such as en.

endMs.description: End offset in milliseconds, not less than startMs.

startMs.description: Start offset from recording start in milliseconds.

segments.description: Complete ordered segment list; [] requests no transcript segments.

recorderIds.description: Complete replacement list of credited recorder user identifiers; obtain IDs from list-users. Empty attribution is not exposed.

participants.description: Complete replacement participant list; [] clears participants. Segment keys without a participant become anonymous speakers.

name.description: Participant name; at least one of name, email, or phone is required.

email.description: Participant email address; at least one identifying field is required.

phone.description: Participant phone number; at least one identifying field is required.

speakerKey.description: Key linking transcript segments to this participant.

attributes.description: Partial attribute changes. Omission preserves a field; null is not accepted. Arrays and transcript are replacements, not appends.

FunctionInput_grain_api_key_updateupload.description: Upload identifier and partial replacement recording attributes.

id.description: Identifier of the edited upload, unchanged by the edit.

status.description: Current lifecycle state; the edit does not itself promote the upload.

tags.instructions: Obtain uploadId from `create-upload` or `list-uploads`, then inspect `get-upload` if its state is uncertain. Only awaiting or staged uploads with autoPromote=false can be edited. Use this to correct metadata or replace participants/transcript before `create-recording-from-upload`; it does not edit a recording that already exists. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Empty participants clears that list; null is not a clearing mechanism. Do not replay an ambiguous write before inspecting the upload.
